diagnostics.message: The `adot` add-on deployed by `module.eks-addons` requires cert-manager to be installed and ready, but cert-manager is created by `module.base`, not `module.ctl`. `module.eks-addons` only has `depends_on = [module.ctl]`; it has no direct dependency on `module.base`. The cert-manager ordering currently only holds indirectly because `module.ctl` happens to `depends_on module.base`, so the real requirement (adot → cert-manager from base) is not expressed directly. It should depend directly on `module.base` (a bare `depends_on` is appropriate here since adot consumes no output of the cert-manager module).
